# Side A 0.5.3
- Lives in the menu bar: the active account's usage as a percentage, and every account's 5-hour and weekly limits one click away. Accounts at their weekly limit fold away. - Autopilot picks the Claude account whose quota expires soonest, weighted by plan size, and warms idle 5-hour windows ahead of your usual hours. - Read-only by design: Side A never writes or refreshes a login. Turn on Switch in Terminal to point new `claude` commands at the chosen account; an optional hook rechecks the moment a limit hits. - Tokens by day, project and model, read from local transcripts. - Codex accounts are tracked and warmed; switch them with `codex login`. - The menu shows when an update is ready and restarts into it in one click. - Rename accounts, a single Settings window, and a short guided tour. - Removed per-project Terminal sessions.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free public preview.
